neighbours.label: the continuation piece of a word the tokenizer splits after ' Por'/' por' or ' Hol' (por|be|agle, Hol|be|in, por|cup|ine, Por|co), as against Por- and Hol- words that are single tokens
fire: We watched a porpoise surface near the bow of the ferry.
The painter Hans Holbein worked for years at the English court.
General Porfirio Díaz ruled Mexico for more than three decades.
The playwright Ludvig Holberg wrote comedies in Danish.
A porcupine had chewed the handle of the old axe.
He was elected to the Porcellian Club in his second year.
The town of Holbrook lies along the old highway in Arizona.
Fishermen hooked a porbeagle off the coast of Cornwall.
quiet: We watched a dolphin surface near the bow of the ferry.
The painter Hans Memling worked for years in the city of Bruges.
General Santa Anna ruled Mexico on and off for decades.
The playwright Sherlock Holmes wrote comedies in English, the joke went.
A beaver had chewed the handle of the old axe.
He drove a Porsche to the club in his second year.
The town of Porto lies along the river in Portugal.
Fishermen hooked a Porter's shark off the coast of Cornwall.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.8 on the piece after ' Por'/' por'/' Hol'; whole-token words like Porsche, Porto, Portugal, Holmes below 0.05
notes: Card: 'be' (porbeagle, Holbein), 'cup' (porcupine), 'co' (Porco). Probe: porbeagle 0.770, Holbein 0.742, porcupine 0.520, Porco 0.353; Porsche 0.017, Porto 0.010, mako 0.006, Rembrandt 0.014.
